title: Run
description: issues/<id>/library/runs/<n>.json: one record of a command a worker ran as evidence, with its output kept beside it in runs/<n>.log. Written only by `andon issue record`, which runs the command in the issue's worktree and checks the record before writing it; never by hand. One file per run, never rewritten, kept after finish. A row of report.json acceptance[] points at it by id (acceptance[].run). Only these keys.

id.description: The record's number n (runs/<n>.json): 1, 2, ... in the order the runs started. Unique in the issue.

command.description: The command and its arguments as given after --, run without a shell.

expect.description: What the worker expected: pass (exit code 0) or fail (an exit code other than 0; a check that must fail when the mistake is put back).

exit_code.description: The command's exit code. -1 when it was ended by a signal.

commit.description: HEAD of the worktree when the run started: 40 lowercase hex digits. Present for an issue with a repository, absent for an issue without one.

dirty.description: Whether the worktree had changes not in commit (git status --porcelain, untracked files included) when the run started. Present exactly when commit is.

output.description: Where the output is, relative to the issue's library/: runs/<n>.log with the same n as id. Standard output and standard error together, in the order written.

output_bytes.description: Bytes the command wrote in all, before any cut.

truncated.description: Whether the output was over the limit and only its end was kept (the log then starts with one line saying how much was cut).

time.description: UTC time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, a real calendar date and time.
